labels.shortDescription: Nightly jobs page: heading
Nightly jobs page: what the page is for
labels.value: Three jobs keep commitments moving overnight: they extend recurring schedules, mark payments overdue, and place donors on their giving level. Until you schedule them here, none of them runs.

labels.shortDescription: Nightly jobs page: the top up job and when it runs
Nightly jobs page: what the top up job does
labels.value: Extends every active recurring commitment up to the generation horizon.

labels.shortDescription: Nightly jobs page: the overdue pass and when it runs
Nightly jobs page: what the overdue pass does
labels.value: Marks an unpaid payment Overdue once it is further past its due date than the grace period.

labels.shortDescription: Nightly jobs page: the donor level pass and when it runs
Nightly jobs page: what the donor level pass does
labels.value: Places every donor on the rung their giving now reaches. Runs after the rollups have settled.

labels.shortDescription: Nightly jobs page: what the last top up run did
